{{Quote|You've done a great service for the A.C.L.O. and for me. Please stop by our office any time and say hello!|[[Trezya Nenei]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RttR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Report to the Rebels|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''A.C.L.O. office''' was an office building on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] used by the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I would like you to dispense justice on behalf of the Empire to five of these terrorists operating out of the local A.C.L.O. office.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk|Ekirk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II" />}}
[[File:ACLOOffice2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An aerial view of the A.C.L.O. office building and shuttleport.]]
The A.C.L.O. office was located on the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. It was constructed in the [[Akazi Plains]] just east of the large [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]]. The building server as the headquarters of the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization,<ref name="SWG:II" /> a political group and medical supply company affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the Galactic Civil War against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:CoA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Crisis of Allegiance|Talus}}</ref> In addition to their main office building, their property included a closely constructed shuttleport. In addition to other personnel who staffed the A.C.L.O. offices, several [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] worked in the buildings. The A.C.L.O. offices and the surrounding area were patrolled by A.C.L.O. [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="SWG:II" />

==History==
{{Quote|Since you are going to be there, I want you to contact a covert operative we have inside the office.|[[Galiir Ac Yandar]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization was in conflict with the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], a Talusian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization affiliated with the Empire.<ref name="SWG:RI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Investigation|Talus}}</ref> At some point, the N.S.H. managed to infiltrate a [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Mark Hieks]], in the A.C.L.O. office.<ref name="SWG:MHDCA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Mark Hieks, Deep Cover Agent|Talus}}</ref>

[[File:ACLO.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A.C.L.O. staff in the A.C.L.O. office.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the N.S.H. was negotiating its integration into the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. However, the negotiations were disturbed when A.C.L.O. slicers planted information that almost ruined the reputation of the N.S.H. commander, [[Galiir Ac Yandar]]. In retaliation, Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk|Ekirk]] dispatched a spacer to raid the A.C.L.O. office.<ref name="SWG:II" /> The spacer was recommended by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] who wanted to determine what kind of people the Rebellion had chosen to work with.<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> The spacer attacked the building and slained A.C.L.O. terrorists who sabotaged Imperial shipments. The Imperial agent also investigated the A.C.L.O. slicers and finally discovered that [[Leeta Poandeu]] was the slicer who was responsible for slicing Yandar's system. The spacer then killed the woman in the central computer control room of the building.<ref name="SWG:II" /> Meanwhile, the N.S.H. spy Mark Hieks attempted to place sliceware monitoring components on several A.C.L.O. computers but he was almost got caught and had to injure himself to shift the focus away from what he was doing. The spacer thus placed monitoring devices on the A.C.L.O's medical computer, personal computer, operations computer, and equipment manifest computer, achieving successfully Hieks' mission.<ref name="SWG:MHDCA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The A.C.L.O. office was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:II" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The A.C.L.O. office was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
